text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic complete hollow outfit, no person, skin or visible mannequin, pure white seamless background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3, fully uncropped. Garments: Fitted blue gray leather zip jacket with pushed-up sleeves, teal scoop-neck fitted long sleeve top over white lace camisole, dark blue low-rise bootcut jeans, black shoes.. Add ONLY these accessories: A layered silver necklace with a short fine chain and a long chain carrying small beads and a dark elongated pendant. Present together as one layered necklace.; A women’s medium black leather shoulder bag with a long slim strap and small metal fittings.. Use each accessory once. Neckties are tied with one knot and the narrow tail hidden; for sweater layers tuck the long tail under the sweater. No additional accessories or props.
original_prompt: Create ONE complete photorealistic hollow wardrobe outfit on a pure white background, portrait 2:3, soft studio light. FIRST reference is the exact clothing base; preserve its cuts, colors, layers and footwear. Other references are individual accessory products belonging to this look. Garments: Fitted blue gray leather zip jacket with pushed-up sleeves, teal scoop-neck fitted long sleeve top over white lace camisole, dark blue low-rise bootcut jeans, black shoes.. Add EXACTLY these accessories and no others: A layered silver necklace with a short fine chain and a long chain carrying small beads and a dark elongated pendant. Present together as one layered necklace.; A women’s medium black leather shoulder bag with a long slim strap and small metal fittings.. Arrange as a single cohesive empty outfit: tie at collar, belt at waist, scarf draped naturally, hat/eyewear hovering above empty neck if present, necklace around empty collar; bag beside hip with full strap. Watches, gloves or small jewelry can be placed neatly beside outfit, each once. No visible person, body, face, skin, hands, legs, mannequin, stand or hanger. Empty neck and sleeves. Preserve fully visible garments, shoes, accessory shapes, full chains and straps within frame. No source photos, collages, labels, text, props or watermark.
